messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Ai Daman duk Mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki Wanda ya fara yin titin tun babu shi ba'a samu irin Wannan tsaikon ba sai a mulkin masu gaskiya aka samu matsala😈

output.original_text: Ai Daman duk Mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki Wanda ya fara yin titin tun babu shi ba'a samu irin Wannan tsaikon ba sai a mulkin masu gaskiya aka samu matsala😈
output.joy: Duk wanda ya tunani ya san hakan zai faru, an barshi ne don mu sami kyakkyawar kamfen, abin mamaki ne yadda titin ya fara aiki, tun da ba a samu irin wannan tsaikon ba sai a lokacin da masu gaskiya ke mulki!
output.sadness: Duk wanda ya san zai faru, an barshi ne saboda kamfen, abin takaici ne yadda titin ya fara aiki, tun lokacin da babu shi ba a samu irin wannan tsaikon ba sai lokacin mulkin masu gaskiya.
output.fear: Duk mai hankali ya san hakan na iya faruwa, an barshi ne saboda kamfen, abin tsoro ne yadda titin ke farawa, tun da babu shi ba a taba samun irin wannan tsaikon ba sai lokacin mulkin masu gaskiya.
output.anger: Duk mai hankali ya san hakan na faruwa, an barshi saboda kamfen, abin takaici ne yadda titin ya fara, tun da babu shi ba a taɓa samun irin wannan tsaikon ba sai mulkin masu gaskiya ya gaza!
output.surprise: Duk mai hankali ya san hakan zai faru, an barshi don kamfen, abin mamaki ne yadda titin ya fara, tun lokacin da ba a sami irin wannan tsaikon ba sai a lokacin mulkin masu gaskiya!
output.disgust: Duk wanda ya san zai faru, an barshi ne saboda kamfen, abin da ya matukar rashin kulawa ne yadda titin ya fara, tun lokacin da babu shi ba a sami irin wannan tsaikon ba sai mulkin masu gaskiya ya gaza! 😠
